questions: How should nested elements with the same tag be merged? For example, if a parent and child share the same tag, should their texts be concatenated, or should only one row be output?
Should the CSV include a header row? If so, what should the column headers be?
What encoding should be used for reading the XML string and writing the CSV file? The reference uses utf-8 for writing, but is that required?
Should the CSV output include all elements from the XML, including the root element, or only certain ones (e.g., exclude root)?
How should XML attributes be handled? Should they be ignored, included in the CSV as separate columns, or merged with the text?
What should happen if an element has both text and child elements? Should the text be included, or only child elements?
Should the CSV rows be ordered in a specific way (e.g., depth-first traversal as in iter()), or is any order acceptable?
If the XML contains namespaces in tags, should they be preserved in the CSV, or stripped?
